title: Peak to Peak Scenic Byway and Estes Park
blurb: Experience the beauty of the Rocky Mountains on our guided small group tour. Travel north through Boulder, home of the University of Colorado, health food, and mountain climbers. Drive up scenic and rugged Boulder Canyon, stop to see rock climbers on the steep walls. Visit Nederland for a coffee or pastry before continuing on and experiencing incredible Rocky Mountain scenery on the Peak to Peak Scenic and Historic Byway. Witness majestic views of the Indian Peaks Wilderness Area and Rocky Mountain National Park. Enjoy a stroll around Lily Lake nestled in between picturesque mountain peaks before visiting the mountain village of Estes Park. Enjoy lunch on your own and explore the local artisan shops along Elk Horn Avenue and visit the historic Stanley Hotel. Look for a variety of wildlife including herds of grazing elk, mule deer, moose and more.
